reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a BTCC-branded account, fiat-deposit, and spot-trading walkthrough as educational and informational. Although it includes bonus language and requests to register, deposit, or follow an account, the available video evidence describes no established deception, completed payment or identity submission, or resulting loss. Cryptocurrency-risk warnings and advice to conduct independent research further support an educational and cautionary context.

citations.quote: BTCC Sign Up Tutorial | Claim Your 10% Deposit Bonus Now
Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below
This `educational tutorials` provides a step-by-step guide on how to make a `fiat deposit` on the `BTCC` platform.

opening.argument: Judge, the offer is tied to a specific action: the description promises a 10% deposit bonus and up to $10,055 USDT for signing up through its exclusive link, then says to register now. The tutorial carries that invitation through to a fiat-deposit flow, including credit-card entry and selection of a payment amount. This is more than a general explanation of trading. It asks viewers to move toward providing payment details in pursuit of an advertised reward, without establishing in the cited material what a viewer must do to receive the advertised maximum.

citations.quote: Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below Register Now 👉 https://bit.ly/3NzaAjl
This `educational tutorials` provides a step-by-step guide on how to make a `fiat deposit` on the `BTCC` platform.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this a walkthrough, but that describes its format, not the purpose of placing a reward beside registration and deposit instructions. Nor does the absence of a documented loss resolve whether the invitation is misleading before anyone acts. The risk disclaimer concerns investment decisions; it does not explain the conditions for receiving the prominently advertised bonus.

citations.quote: Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below
Cryptocurrency investments involve risks, and viewers are encouraged to conduct their own research and seek professional advice before making any investment decisions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited material shows an advertised signup offer and a deposit tutorial, not that the bonus is false, that viewers must pay to claim an otherwise free asset, or that their payment details go somewhere other than the depicted BTCC flow. The description expressly frames the video as a fiat-deposit guide and cautions viewers about investment risk. Missing bonus terms warrant scrutiny, but their absence from these excerpts does not establish deception.

citations.quote: This `educational tutorials` provides a step-by-step guide on how to make a `fiat deposit` on the `BTCC` platform.
Cryptocurrency investments involve risks, and viewers are encouraged to conduct their own research and seek professional advice before making any investment decisions.

opening.argument: Consider the signals together. The title urges viewers to claim a deposit bonus now; the description pairs a much larger USDT bonus with an exclusive, shortened registration link. It separately offers 10 USDT for following an account. The sampled sequence then reaches an identity-document selection screen and credit-card instructions. Each element might have an ordinary explanation on its own. In combination, the reward language, immediate registration prompt, external link, and progression toward sensitive information give the judge reason to treat this as a potentially deceptive reward-claim solicitation, not merely a neutral account demonstration.

citations.quote: BTCC Sign Up Tutorial | Claim Your 10% Deposit Bonus Now
Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below Register Now 👉 https://bit.ly/3NzaAjl

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to BTCC branding and educational framing, but neither verifies the destination behind the shortened link or the conditions of either reward. Its argument that no completed identity submission or loss is shown addresses an outcome, while the concern here is the invitation: rewards are placed before screens for identity and payment information. A disclaimer about crypto risk does not settle those questions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those signals are compatible with an ordinary exchange promotion and onboarding tutorial. A shortened link does not establish a malicious destination, and the cited frames show interface steps rather than proof that a viewer submitted an ID or card details. The description identifies BTCC's website and gives an explicit investment-risk warning. The prosecution's concern is worth checking, but its citations do not verify deceptive terms or misuse of information.

citations.quote: Not financial advice. Cryptocurrency investments involve risks, and viewers are encouraged to conduct their own research and seek professional advice before making any investment decisions.

opening.argument: The educational label should not obscure what this walkthrough does. Its title leads with claiming a deposit bonus, and its description asks viewers to register through an exclusive link. The demonstrated path proceeds from account creation to choosing a fiat deposit, entering credit-card information, and then switching to a spot-trading page. That sequence is useful instruction, but it also removes friction between a reward promise and participation with money. Judge the video by that promotional function: the tutorial is the vehicle carrying viewers toward the advertised bonus, not evidence that the bonus is explained or substantiated.

citations.quote: BTCC Sign Up Tutorial | Claim Your 10% Deposit Bonus Now
Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below Register Now 👉 https://bit.ly/3NzaAjl

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense accurately identifies account, deposit, and trading instruction, but that is also the route by which the viewer is steered from the advertised offer toward participation. Calling the steps educational does not establish that the large bonus is attainable on the terms a viewer might infer. The cautionary disclaimer addresses investment risk, not the promotional claim's conditions.

citations.quote: Get 10% DEPOSIT BONUS and up to $10,055 USDT BONUS by signing up to BTCC with the BTCC YouTube EXCLUSIVE LINK below

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can promote a service without being a scam. Here, the cited frames show the operational steps the description says it will cover, including fiat deposit and spot trading. The defense does not need to prove every bonus condition from the video alone; the prosecution needs evidence that the offer or pathway deceives viewers. Its citations show promotion and instruction, but no false term, diverted payment, or demonstrated harm.
